image_description: A side-profile view of a Triceratops model or statue against a plain white background. The dinosaur is quadrupedal with textured, brownish-grey skin resembling scales. It features a large bony frill at the rear of the head, two prominent brow horns, and a smaller nasal horn. The forelimbs appear shorter than the hindlimbs, creating a sloping back. The image appears to be a photograph of a physical object rather than a direct AI generation, though it may be an AI-generated image of a model.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Three prominent horns: two long brow horns projecting forward and upward above the eyes, and a shorter nasal horn on the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The two brow horns are clearly visible projecting forward/upward. The nasal horn is present on the snout, appearing shorter than the brow horns, consistent with the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beak is parrot-like with a sharp, keratinous cutting edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth area terminates in a distinct, curved beak structure typical of ceratopsians.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is quadrupedal with columnar, elephant-like limbs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject stands on four legs which are thick and columnar, supporting the heavy body mass visually.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Enormous bony frill (neck shield) extending posteriorly from the skull, with width dramatically exceeding the skull itself.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, semi-circular frill extends from the back of the head. While perspective limits full width assessment, it is clearly a dominant feature larger than the facial portion of the skull.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Frill is solid bone with a smooth outer surface and possible epoccipital (marginal) bumps.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frill appears solid (not fenestrated). The texture is somewhat rough/scaly rather than perfectly smooth, but 'possible bumps' allows for this variation. No holes are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is inferred to have been covered in large, hexagonal scales with possible quill-like structures along the back and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture is highly detailed with a pebbled/scaly appearance. There are raised nodules or spine-like structures along the back/flank area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forelimbs are shorter than hindlimbs creating a sloping backline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder height is visibly lower than the hip height, creating the characteristic downward slope towards the head.
The tail is completely cut off by the right edge of the image frame; it cannot be evaluated.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The feet, particularly the hind feet, lack clear digit definition. They appear somewhat fused into the ground plane or indistinctly molded, lacking the sharp separation of individual toes expected in a high-quality model or render.
The far edge of the frill seems to warp slightly inconsistently with the rest of the head's perspective, possibly due to the curvature of the object or slight lens distortion, but it is minor.
